description: This file is a Markdown document discussing how to implement custom Request and APIRoute classes in FastAPI. It covers use cases like handling custom request body encodings such as gzip, creating custom Request subclasses, and customizing route handling for advanced request processing scenarios.

classes.name: GzipRequest
classes.description: A custom subclass of Request to handle automatic gzip decompression of request bodies.

classes.name: GzipRoute
classes.description: A custom subclass of APIRoute that uses GzipRequest to process incoming requests with potential gzip encoding.

methods.name: GzipRequest.body
methods.description: Overridden method to decompress gzip request bodies if the Content-Encoding header indicates gzip.

methods.name: GzipRoute.get_route_handler
methods.description: Overridden method that returns a route handler which creates a GzipRequest instance for processing.
